# Data inventory

<!-- Generated by scripts/data_inventory.py from docs/data-inventory.json. Do not edit. -->

Every data file under `examples/*/data/` with its sha256, size and row count. Edit the datasets in `docs/data-inventory.json`, then run `python scripts/data_inventory.py update`. CI runs `check` and fails when a data file, a hash or this page is out of date.

Kinds: `real` (recorded on hardware), `simulated` (generated from a known model), `generated` (computed configuration or result, not a measurement), `derived` (processed from a recording), `notes` (documentation shipped with the data), `unspecified` (the repository does not say; see the list below).

## Provenance to confirm

- `ur10-hand-eye`: sensor and frame convention are undocumented
- `ur10-calibration-simulation`: no README entry or saved generator says how this file was produced
- `tiago-base-parameter-list`: not used by identification.py and not audited
- `tiago-calibration-nov-30-64`: not used by identification.py and not audited
- `staubli-tx40-logs`: the README does not say whether the logs were recorded or simulated, or when

### `ur10-identification-truth`

Simulated truth fixture: known inertias, exact clock and RNEA effort, 2400 training and 800 validation samples, with the truth URDF and parameters, frozen waypoints, manifest and benchmark protocol. The UR10 has no hardware identification recordings.
